name: kiki-documents
description: Extract local PDF, Office, HTML and text documents into readable Markdown with source metadata; explicit cloud MinerU for OCR.

nbExtractPath.title: nb-extract package root (optional)
nbExtractPath.description: Leave empty for the bundled @nb-corp/nb-extract 0.1.1. Override with an absolute path to that version's package root, containing package.json and dist/index.mjs.

pythonPath.title: Python with MarkItDown
pythonPath.description: Local PDF/Office needs Python >=3.10 with the matching MarkItDown format extras installed. Use an absolute interpreter path for a virtual environment; otherwise nb-extract uses PYTHON or python. The plugin does not install Python or pip dependencies.

mineruToken.title: MinerU token (cloud OCR only)
mineruToken.description: Only used for explicit engine=mineru with allowUpload=true. Service terms and charges apply; never an automatic fallback. Empty uses the standard package's MINERU_TOKEN environment variable.

mineruBaseUrl.title: MinerU-compatible hosted API (optional)
mineruBaseUrl.description: Leave empty for the standard package default or MINERU_BASE_URL. A hosted API endpoint, not the different self-hosted MinerU protocol.

tools.name: documents_extract
tools.description: Extract one local PDF, Office, HTML or text document into a NEW output directory using nb-extract. Returns Markdown/asset paths, source, engine, warnings and a bounded preview; use Read/Grep on document.md. Auto is local and never does OCR or uploads. Empty content fails; local scans without a text layer need explicit OCR. MinerU explicitly uploads and requires allowUpload=true. Never overwrites source or outputs.

file.description: Workspace-relative file or explicitly approved absolute path.

outputDir.description: New workspace-relative or explicitly approved output directory. Must not exist.

allowUpload.description: Only set true when the user explicitly authorized sending this file to MinerU; required with engine=mineru.
